decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 14th September 2017 and numbered Site Location Plan, and submitted 27th October 2017 and numbered 4BR/HO/P2, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the proposal hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 4 Burlington Road, Isleworth, TW7 4LY and shall not be used as primary residential accommodation, for business purposes or as a separate dwelling.
description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding in the rear garden for ancillary use to the house.
